{{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Courser Bee Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Courser Bee Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoI |era= {{List| * [[Era of Foundation]] * [[Era of the Wilds]] }} |habitat= |attack= |weapon= |cost= |value= |characteristics= |members= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Courser Bee|Courser Bees|Series, BotW, TotK, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Animal]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Courser Bees can be found in swarms, with each swarm guarding one piece of [[Courser Bee Honey]]. When [[Link]] approaches, they attack, dealing minimal damage. They can be targeted and take two hits to scare off, but don't officially appear in the [[Hyrule Compendium]]. They appear on the [[Great Plateau]] during ''[[The Champions' Ballad]]'', where they are a major threat, as they are ferocious and the [[One-Hit Obliterator]] forces Link to be stuck on a quarter of a [[Heart]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Courser Bees return in {{TotK}}. When a piece of [[Courser Bee Honey]] is [[Fuse]]d to a [[Weapon]], swinging it causes a swarm of Courser Bees to appear and attack [[Enemy|Enemies]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoI|-}}=== During his [[Weak-Point Smash]]es, [[Calamo]] will often throw [[Courser Bee Honey]] toward [[Enemy|Enemies]], which summons a swarm of Courser Bees to attack them. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Courser Bee Swarm Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A swarm of Courser Bees File:BotW Courser Bee Concept Artwork.jpg|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Courser Bee on a comb of Courser Bee Honey {{Ref| {{Cite Book|quote= '''Courser Bee'''|book= CaC|publisher= |page= 165}} {{Cite|{{Big|Courser Bee Honey}}|Inventory|TotK}} {{Cite|{{Big|Courser Bee Honey}}
